response.sql: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees), channel_rates AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees WHERE orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - a.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_above_average FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > a.avg_fee_rate
